title: CBS Complete Broadcast Day: D-Day
paragraphs: An archival collection preserving CBS radio programming and wartime news coverage surrounding D-Day, allowing listeners to hear the developing events in the context of a broadcast day rather than as isolated clips.

Preservation collection containing CBS Radio’s continuous D-Day broadcast day in 24 roughly hour-long sequential segments. These archive segments contain news bulletins, correspondent reports, relays and ordinary scheduled programming rather than 24 discrete historical series episodes.
GRH documents the program through CBS D-Day complete broadcast day (June 6, 1944 to June 7, 1944) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include D-Day and the Normandy landings, breaking wartime news, American home-front listening, continuous network broadcast flow, ordinary programming amid breaking news, and transatlantic correspondent and BBC relays.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including D-Day Normandy landings, CBS continuous D-Day broadcast-day preservation, and Coverage continues into June 7.
